prohibited_practices: real-time remote biometric identification in public spaces for law enforcement (with exceptions)
AI systems used to infer emotions in the workplace (except medical or safety purposes)
manipulative and deceptive techniques by AI systems likely to cause significant harm
practices prohibited under Article 5 AI Act
implementation_notes: These are Commission guidelines interpreting Article 5 of the EU AI Act on prohibited practices. They are not themselves binding law but provide the Commission's interpretation. Ireland and Denmark have opt-out provisions for certain RBI prohibitions. Prohibitions apply to placing on market, putting into service, and use, including misuse. General-purpose AI systems are covered. Continuous compliance throughout AI lifecycle is required.
